Between January 3 and January 8, 2024, Burträsk, Sweden, experienced a significant warming trend. Temperatures began at an extreme low of -33.25°C (feeling like -40.25°C) under overcast skies, eventually rising to a peak of 2.62°C by January 8. The period transitioned from heavy cloud cover and high humidity (100%) to clear skies around January 6, accompanied by a steady increase in wind speeds and gusts toward the end of the forecast.

Between January 3rd and 8th, Birchington experienced a steady cooling trend, with temperatures dropping from highs of around 9.5°C to a low of 3.85°C. The period was characterized by frequent precipitation, including light to moderate rain, particularly between January 4th and 7th. Winds remained consistently strong, peaking around 16.7 m/s on January 5th, while sky conditions shifted from broken clouds to predominantly overcast.

Weather in Riaillé, France, from January 3 to 8, 2024, will transition from mild, cloudy conditions to colder temperatures. Temperatures peak at 12.16°C on January 4, followed by a steady decline to a low of 1.59°C by January 8. Light rain is expected periodically, most notably on the afternoon of January 4. Winds will generally moderate after an initial gusty period, and skies will fluctuate between overcast and few clouds.

Weather in Broughton from January 3rd to 8th will transition from wet and mild to cold and clear. Initial days feature light rain and temperatures around 6-8°C, followed by overcast skies on January 4th. Conditions clear significantly by January 6th, with temperatures dropping steadily to a low of 0.04°C by the morning of January 8th. Pressure rises from 991 hPa to 1036 hPa over the period, coinciding with the shift toward clear, colder weather.

From January 3rd to 8th, Aridaea experienced a transition from scattered clouds and mild temperatures (peaking at 15.89°C on Jan 4th) to increasingly overcast skies. The period ended with a significant stretch of rain starting the evening of January 6th and continuing through January 8th, accompanied by a cooling trend with temperatures dropping to a low of 7.59°C.

Between January 3rd and 8th, Sherwood experienced fluctuating temperatures ranging from a low of 1.08°C to a peak of 11.12°C on January 7th. The period was characterized by mostly clear to cloudy skies, with a notable instance of light rain on January 5th. Winds remained generally light to moderate, peaking at 5.38 m/s by the end of the period.

From January 3rd to 8th, Saint James experienced fluctuating winter weather with temperatures ranging from a high of 6.99°C to a low of -3.56°C. The period began with clear skies, transitioned to overcast conditions with light snow on January 5th and 7th and light rain on January 6th, and concluded with overcast skies.

Between January 3 and January 8, Rio Chico experienced warm temperatures ranging from a low of 23.01°C to a peak of 30.28°C. The period was characterized by frequent light rain and high humidity, often exceeding 90% overnight, with weather alternating between overcast skies and occasional clear intervals.

The forecast for Semeljci shows a significant cooling trend from January 3rd to 8th. Temperatures will drop from highs of around 13°C to lows reaching -1.2°C. Weather conditions will transition from initial overcast skies and light rain to consistent light rain and eventually snow by January 7th and 8th, accompanied by a notable decrease in visibility and shifting wind patterns.

Between January 3 and January 8, Betz, France, will experience a significant cooling trend, with temperatures dropping from highs around 9.9°C to lows of -0.3°C. The period starts with frequent light rain and overcast skies, transitioning to cloudy conditions, and ending with light snow and freezing temperatures by January 8.

Between January 3 and January 8, Ébano, Mexico, experienced variable cloud cover and temperatures ranging from a low of 15.73°C to a peak of 28.62°C. The period began with broken and overcast clouds, transitioned to clear skies around January 5-6, and returned to overcast conditions by January 7-8. Humidity peaked at 96% during the latter half of the period, while wind speeds remained generally light, mostly under 6 m/s.

Between January 3 and January 8, Pyhäjoki experienced a significant warming trend, with temperatures rising from a low of -26.8°C to a high of -3.66°C. The period began with mostly cloudy skies and extreme cold, transitioning to overcast conditions by January 7 as temperatures climbed and wind speeds increased, peaking around 7.79 m/s with gusts up to 13.51 m/s.

The weather forecast for Târgu Trotuş shows a significant transition from overcast and mild conditions (peaking at 12.57°C on Jan 4) to a severe cold snap. Starting Jan 7, temperatures plummet, dropping below freezing and reaching a low of -7.23°C by Jan 8. This temperature drop coincides with heavy, continuous snowfall and significantly reduced visibility, with winds remaining steady from the north.

In Nakskov, Denmark, the weather will transition from moderate rain and temperatures around 6°C on January 3rd to light snow and freezing conditions by January 4th. Following this, the period will be characterized by overcast skies and steady temperatures hovering between -3°C and 1°C, eventually clearing to sunny skies by January 8th. Wind speeds will remain moderate throughout, peaking during the transition to snow.
